sloka: सर्वे तु शिरसा भूमावभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च ।प्रत्यूचू राघवं दीनमेवमेतन्न संशयः ।। ७.४३.२२ ॥
transliteration: sarve tu śirasā bhūmāvabhivādya praṇamya ca ।pratyūcū rāghavaṁ dīnamevametanna saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.43.22 ॥

translations.english: All of them, having saluted and bowed down with their heads to the ground, replied to the distressed Rama, "This is indeed so, there is no doubt."
